build.notes: Out-of-tree build with the bundled oniguruma and static libraries. A single-process pthread shim (compat/jq-single-process.c in this directory) is compiled without coverage flags and linked through LIBS; it runs jq's worker threads sequentially. GCC records the generated lexer and parser sources (lexer.c, lexer.l, parser.c, parser.y) under obj-gcov/src, where they do not exist; build.stage_sources lists the copies that put them there, which the builder makes after the build and the runner repeats, so that the initial lcov capture prints no warning.
